title: Screens and service activation
slide_intent: Carry a recognizable visual language from promotion into setup so users can connect a promise with the service they activate.
strategic_value: Related colored environments can connect Xfinity’s advertising, hardware and app onboarding.
demonstration: The clip moves between a floating campaign screen, a remote and set-top device, and portrait setup screens that end with a gateway-connected confirmation.
practical_value: Compare promotional and functional screens together to decide which brand elements remain useful during setup.

content_islands.name: Campaign screen
content_islands.spec: Show the orange portrait campaign on a floating landscape display with copy and the X at left of the person.

content_islands.name: Hardware pair
content_islands.spec: Present the remote and device together on the saturated stage.

content_islands.name: Activation screens
content_islands.spec: Present the portrait phone with a light setup interface, then the colored confirmation state.

reference_purposes.Expression: Saturated stage colors and dimensional device presentations recur across the sequence.
reference_purposes.Application: The montage carries the identity from campaign imagery into a gateway activation flow.
